planets.name: TOI-1728 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1728 with a 3.49-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-1728 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1728. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
